title: erodium pimpinellifolium var. lebelii
intro: Erodium pimpinellifolium var. lebelii, commonly known as the Pink Stork's Bill or Herbe aux Champs, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Geranium family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Mediterranean region, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium pimpinellifolium var. lebelii include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable natural remedy for skin issues and minor injuries. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
